name: multisolute_pore
description: High-fidelity 3-D reference for multisolute thermophoretic localization: a representative converging-diverging pore (dolfinx FEM, gmsh tetrahedral mesh) in which several solutes are transported SIMULTANEOUSLY, each with its own diffusivity, Soret coefficient, adsorption and degradation, under a shared flow + hot-inlet/cold-outlet temperature field. Reports per-species trap enrichment (peak/feed) and the mixture's worst-pair spatial co-localization -- whether the chemically-necessary mixture concentrates together or fractionates. Runs under viva-fenics's pixi env (dolfinx).

peclet.description: Advective Peclet number (w L / D_mean) of the pore flow

delta_T.description: Hot-inlet to cold-outlet temperature drop driving Soret

n_steps.description: Backward-Euler steps to near steady state

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
